landlock_rules.kernel_note: INTENT ONLY: Landlock requires Linux >= 5.13; this device runs 4.14.253.

network_policy.kernel_note: The permission manager talks to org.nuxel.Portal over the SYSTEM D-Bus socket, not the network; no ACCEPT rule is emitted.

enforcement.apparmor: profile configs/apparmor.d/usr.bin.nuxel-permissions; only effective if AppArmor is enabled
enforcement.note: This app is the reviewer: it must display mechanism, attacker class and limitation per capability, sourced from capabilities.json. It never upgrades a 'partial' to 'enforced'.
